### summarize number of peaks truncation

```{r}
summarize_truncation <- function(lib_list,
                                 overlape_df = NULL,
                                 col_name = NULL,
                                 max_isotope = 2) {
  proton <- 1.007276
  iso_shift <- 1.0034
  
  # ---------------- Subset library if overlap info is provided ----------------
  if (!is.null(overlape_df) && !is.null(col_name)) {
    if (!col_name %in% colnames(overlape_df)) {
      stop(paste("Column", col_name, "not found in overlape_df"))
    }
    overlape_df_names <- unique(overlape_df[[col_name]])
    lib_list <- lib_list[sapply(lib_list, function(x) x$Name) %in% overlape_df_names]
  }
  
  if (length(lib_list) == 0) {
    warning("No compounds left after filtering! Returning empty result.")
    return(list(summary = data.frame(), plots = NULL, stats = NULL))
  }
  
  # ---------------- Compute before / after counts ----------------
  peak_counts <- data.frame(
    compound = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) cmp$Name %||% NA_character_),
    before   = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        nrow(cmp$Peaks)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    }),
    after    = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        cutoff <- cmp$ExactMass + proton + max_isotope * iso_shift
        sum(cmp$Peaks$mz <= cutoff)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    })
  )
  
  peak_counts$removed <- peak_counts$before - peak_counts$after
  peak_counts$ratio   <- with(peak_counts, ifelse(before > 0, after / before, NA))
  
  # ---------------- Summary statistics ----------------
  stats <- data.frame(
    metric = c("Before", "After", "Removed", "Ratio"),
    mean   = c(mean(peak_counts$before, na.rm = TRUE),
               mean(peak_counts$after,  na.rm = TRUE),
               mean(peak_counts$removed, na.rm = TRUE),
               mean(peak_counts$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median = c(median(peak_counts$before, na.rm = TRUE),
               median(peak_counts$after,  na.rm = TRUE),
               median(peak_counts$removed, na.rm = TRUE),
               median(peak_counts$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    min    = c(min(peak_counts$before, na.rm = TRUE),
               min(peak_counts$after,  na.rm = TRUE),
               min(peak_counts$removed, na.rm = TRUE),
               min(peak_counts$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max    = c(max(peak_counts$before, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(peak_counts$after,  na.rm = TRUE),
               max(peak_counts$removed, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(peak_counts$ratio, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
  
  # ---------------- Plots ----------------
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(peak_counts, aes(x = before, y = after)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = "Peaks Before vs After Truncation",
         x = "Number of Peaks (Before)",
         y = "Number of Peaks (After)") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  hist_plot <- ggplot(peak_counts, aes(x = removed)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Peaks Removed",
         x = "Number of Peaks Removed",
         y = "Count of Compounds") +
    theme_minimal()
  density_plot <- ggplot(peak_counts) +
    geom_density(aes(x = before, color = "Before", fill = "Before"), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_density(aes(x = after,  color = "After",  fill = "After"),  alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Before" = "blue", "After" = "green")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Before" = "blue", "After" = "green")) +
    labs(title = "Density of Peaks per Compound (Before vs After)",
       x = "Number of Peaks",
       y = "Density",
       color = "Group",
       fill  = "Group") +
    theme_minimal()

  ratio_plot <- ggplot(peak_counts, aes(x = after, y = ratio)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(title = "Ratio of Retained Peaks vs Number of Peaks After Truncation",
         x = "Number of Peaks After Truncation",
         y = "Retention Ratio (After/Before)") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  list(summary = peak_counts,
       stats = stats,
       plots = list(scatter = scatter_plot,
                    histogram = hist_plot,
                    density = density_plot,
                    ratio = ratio_plot))
}

```

```{r}
summarize_peak_truncation <- function(lib_list, max_isotope = 2) {
  proton <- 1.007276
  iso_shift <- 1.0034
  
  peak_counts <- data.frame(
    compound = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$Name)) cmp$Name else NA_character_
    }),
    before_truncation = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        nrow(cmp$Peaks)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    }),
    after_truncation = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        cutoff <- cmp$ExactMass + proton + max_isotope * iso_shift
        sum(cmp$Peaks$mz <= cutoff)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    })
  )
  
  peak_counts$removed <- peak_counts$before - peak_counts$after
  
  # ---- Visualization ----
  library(ggplot2)
  library(reshape2)
  
  df_melt <- melt(
    peak_counts,
    id.vars = "compound",
    measure.vars = c("before_truncation", "after_truncation", "removed"),
    variable.name = "Type",
    value.name = "Count"
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = Type, y = Count, fill = Type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "Peak counts before/after truncation",
      x = "",
      y = "Number of Peaks"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p)
  
  return(peak_counts)
}

```

```{r}
summarize_peak_truncation <- function(lib_list, max_isotope = 2, top_n = 30) {
  proton <- 1.007276
  iso_shift <- 1.0034
  
  peak_counts <- data.frame(
    compound = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$Name)) cmp$Name else NA_character_
    }),
    before = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        nrow(cmp$Peaks)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    }),
    after = sapply(lib_list, function(cmp) {
      if (!is.null(cmp$ExactMass) && !is.null(cmp$Peaks)) {
        cutoff <- cmp$ExactMass + proton + max_isotope * iso_shift
        sum(cmp$Peaks$mz <= cutoff)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      }
    })
  )
  
  peak_counts$removed <- peak_counts$before - peak_counts$after
  
  # ---- Visualization ----
  library(ggplot2)
  library(reshape2)
  
  df_melt <- melt(
    peak_counts,
    id.vars = "compound",
    measure.vars = c("before", "after", "removed"),
    variable.name = "Type",
    value.name = "Count"
  )
  
  # Take only top_n compounds (sorted by before)
  top_compounds <- head(peak_counts[order(-peak_counts$before), "compound"], top_n)
  df_melt <- df_melt[df_melt$compound %in% top_compounds, ]
  
  p <- ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = reorder(compound, -Count), y = Count, fill = Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " compounds: peak counts before/after truncation"),
      x = "Compound",
      y = "Number of Peaks"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
  
  print(p)
  
  return(peak_counts)
}

```
